title: Exponential sums over primes
summary: Let $α=a/q+ε$ with $(a,q)=1$, $q\le N^{1/2}$ and $|ε|\le 1/(qN^{1/2})$, and let $B:=\max(q,qN|ε|)$. We show that \[ \Bigl|\sum_{n<N}Λ(n)e(nα)\Bigr|\le N^{o(1)}\Bigl(\frac{N}{B^{1/2}}+N^{19/24}\Bigr). \] This improves on the classical bound of Vinogradov from 1937, which has $N^{4/5}$ in place of $N^{19/24}$.
